item.title: Luzerne County gets more input on zoning plan for data centers
item.description: WILKES-BARRE — The Luzerne County Planning & Zoning Department held a meeting Thursday to get more input on a zoning proposal that would limit data centers to certain zoning districts in 20 municipalities and require zoning board approval. The county planning commission could vote at its March 12 meeting to recommend that county council enact the zoning proposal. item.title: PIAA CLASS 3A WRESTLING: Schechterly, Benyos advance to quarters
item.description: HERSHEY — West Scranton’s Tommy Schechterly and Hazleton Area’s Jake and Gabe Benyo had their eyes on the quarterfinals. The sophomore wrestlers all achieved that goal in different ways. For Schechterly, it was about getting that first takedown and securing early control of the match. For Jake Benyo, it was about getting in position to build the lead with tilts. For Gabe Benyo, it was about doing just enough to stay in the hunt for gold. item.title: COLLEGE SOFTBALL: Wilkes extends win streak to three
item.description: Wilkes University softball team extended its winning streak to three after picking up a pair of victories Thursday in Myrtle Beach, South Carolina. In the first game of the day, the Colonels defeated Grove City College, 5-2, and followed it up with a 5-0 win over Waynesburg University. Against Grove City, the Colonels scored all five runs in the top of the third inning. Olivia Dougher led the Wilkes offense with three hits, including a double and one RBI. item.title: Wright Twp. officials hire engineering firm for work on ice rink
item.description: WRIGHT TWP. – Plans for renovations to the Madry-Kahlau Memorial Ice Rink at Wright Twp. Park are finally moving forward.
